who can count. We need someone who hits
things on time and does not mind the cold.

elements.text:
three people, one amp,
no encore
We started in a laundry room because it was the only place with a socket and no neighbours. Four years, two records and one stolen van later we still play every song faster than we wrote it.

started."

elements.text: Cut your headline out of anything: a newspaper, a bus ticket, a cereal box. Mix sizes. Ugly is correct.
Glue the letters down crooked on one clean sheet. Leave a white margin. A photo goes in the middle, cropped hard.
Photocopy it. Photocopy the copy. Turn the contrast up until the faces go to dots. Stop one copy before you are happy.
